entries.source_evidence: Player exact instruction at accepted Day279 dawn camp: "Continue". Previous Day278→279 intimate overnight with Mara and Fenar was accepted, wilderness Short Rest already completed, LongRest3/6, no Day279 ration/feed debit or Day279 road encounter roll. At Day279 breakfast V's three eating companions Mara/Cirren/Fenar consume3 person-rations, four healthy owned horses4 animal-feed-days, reducing stored21→18 ration-person-days and28→24 feed animal-days (six travel days remain); V Reborn no food use. Sella independently breaks Harrow & Pike company camp and leads her existing three freight wagons, three drivers incl Sella/Idra/Tollen and two hired company guards including Nara, with V's separately owned four-horse coach alongside on the normal maintained Caer Veylan→Eastwatch inland road, loaded-freight pace. Day279 heavily patrolled road chance declared DAY d100 01–07 before RNG; genuine successful Python secrets.uniform d100 FACE90 => NO random daytime encounter. No type/severity draw. There is nevertheless a previously positioned independent local civilian/military freight issue at the FIRST staffed eastbound inspection/receiving lay-by, six road miles from prior camp, reached after normal roughly2–3 hours of travel at about Day279 10:00AM. This is an onstage FIXED world event triggered by arriving at its fixed location, NOT a rerolled random encounter or invented pursuit from earlier gnolls/trolls/WTR quest. Yard 80ft north from road with 20ft unobstructed public bypass lane, no automatic hold/detain/search of V. Harrow & Pike wagons stop for ordinary manifest checks with Sella managing own work; V's party remains with own coach and can choose to help or go. Local adult civilian supply-wagon forewoman ELEN TURR publicly protests to Veyran Guard-profile logistics sergeant ADREN VOS that SIX iron stretcher-frame fittings she carries have been contracted and paid for a civilian convalescent home; Vos insists on checking yard military transport-case inventory before releasing contested material. Two ordinary logistics guards stand at gate, civilian checker at office, Elen's two civilian loaders beside their wagon; no weapon drawn, no assaults, no actual loss of items, no transfer seizure. Elen calls to commercial convoy leader Sella to witness the disputed ownership/transfer, not to V by name; Sella independently says she'll ask the checker rather than automatically take sides. Public documents have NOT yet been compared, hidden private route code/other evidence not made available to V and no new conclusion about authority or secret program. Party agency: V may hear arguments, request appropriate documents, speak to parties, follow Sella, or remain uninvolved and proceed when own company check done. Time ~10AM Day279, next player decision unmade. Everyone uninjured: V48/48HP HD7/7 full Sup4/4, Psi6/6, MP7/7 and fighter abilities; Cirren51/51HD6/6 full spell slots; Fenar59/59HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3; Mara healthy; four healthy horses+coach intact; V purse969gp3sp6cp, carried rations18/feed24, one sealed unused Pixie Dust. LongRest3/6. No new rest, money, spell, feature, gear/custody or encounter combat. Prior resolved Day278 campfire/overnight entries were independently verified and pruned from current recovery journal in background, and already live in main owning CAMPAIGN_STATE; do not duplicate them. Ordinary first contact is not yet a natural sync milestone, and current journal gets no sync_trigger.
